trace.final:
Done. Summary of actions:

1. **Pre-deploy check**: checkout-api was running v2.3.1 in all three production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west), which was unhealthy with an 18% error rate. v2.3.2 had no prior production history, so the deploy was flagged for change-manager approval per policy — it was approved/executed.
2. **Deploy**: v2.3.2 was rolled out to all production regions. Status: rolled_out (VERIFIED).
3. **Incident**: Opened SEV3 incident **INC-0001** ("checkout-api hotfix v2.3.2 deployed to production") documenting the change and the prior unhealthy v2.3.1 state; the on-call engineer has been paged.

Note: I did not follow the deploy with a health verification turn; the deploy tool reported a successful rollout. If you'd like, I can check the service's current health/error rate to confirm the hotfix resolved the elevated error rate.
